gallery.purpose: Three ways to recharge your G31

features.heading: More trips between battery replacements.
features.body: From weekend camping to days on the water, G31 is built for repeated deep-cycle use. Its LiFePO4 cells are rated for 4,000+ cycles at 100% depth of discharge.
features.note: Cycle-life references: 4,000+ cycles at 100% DoD, 6,000 at 80% DoD and 15,000 at 60% DoD. Actual life depends on charging, temperature and use.

features.heading: Know what’s left before you head out.
features.body: Check charge level, voltage, current and temperature through the Bluetooth connection. A quick look at your phone helps you plan the next leg of the trip.

features.heading: Ready for changing conditions.
features.body: The 100A BMS monitors charging and discharge, with protection against overcharge, over-discharge, overcurrent and short circuits. Low-temperature charge protection helps protect the cells when the weather turns cold.
features.note: IP65 protects against dust and water jets; it is not an immersion rating. Charging: 32°F–131°F (0°C–55°C). Discharging: −4°F–140°F (−20°C–60°C).

features.heading: Build the battery bank your setup needs.
features.body: Start with one 12.8V 100Ah battery, then expand with matched batteries as your power needs grow. G31 supports up to four in series and four in parallel, with a maximum 4P4S configuration.
features.note: Use matched batteries and follow the manual for balancing, wiring and system protection. Maximum 4P4S bank: 51.2V 400Ah (20.48kWh).

features.heading: Less weight in the battery bay.
features.body: At about 21.2 lb, G31 is easier to lift, position and install. Check the 13.34 × 7.28 × 8.58 in case dimensions, terminal clearance and hold-down before ordering.

features.heading: Plug in. Drive on. Catch some sun.
features.body: Recharge through a compatible LiFePO4 charger, solar charge controller or DC-to-DC charging setup. Choose the right equipment and charging profile for your system.
features.note: Use 14.4–14.6V LiFePO4 charging. Solar panels and a vehicle alternator require suitable charging equipment; do not connect them directly to the battery.

features.heading: For the campsite, the lake and beyond.
features.body: Keep RV house loads, a compatible trolling motor or an off-grid solar setup supplied. G31 provides 1,280Wh of nominal stored energy in each battery.
features.note: For auxiliary and energy-storage use. G31 is not an engine-starting battery. Runtime depends on the load and system losses.

features.heading: Get to know your G31.
features.body: Check the model documents, charging requirements and installation instructions before building your system. Our product support team can help with setup questions.
